statewideTerm: A general election was held on November 3, 2026; officials elected then take office later (most in January 2027) and are not shown yet. New Hampshire's governor serves a two-year term and was on the November 3, 2026 ballot (Kelly Ayotte was reelected; her new term begins in January 2027). The Secretary of State and Treasurer are chosen by the Legislature, the Attorney General by the governor with the Executive Council. New Hampshire has no lieutenant governor or state auditor; the five-member Executive Council is not listed here yet.
